title: Poker Review Inbox
description: Enveloppe du Review Inbox (poker-review-inbox/v1). Chaque item expose, en plus des champs EV historiques conservés (total_loss_bb, nominal_loss_bb, coverage, analysis_state, deep_link), le résultat réel du hero : hero_net_bb (number|null) et sa projection result {state enum WIN/LOSS/EVEN/UNKNOWN, net_bb number|null}. Côté requête, les codes de tri valides pour sortInboxItems/queryInbox incluent EV_LOSS_DESC (défaut), TIMESTAMP_DESC, TIMESTAMP_ASC, RESULT_GAIN_DESC, RESULT_LOSS_DESC, STATUS_ASC, STREET_ASC, POSITION_ASC et HAND_ID_ASC ; l'enum $defs.review_sort (référencée par le champ sort) liste l'ensemble des codes supportés et tout code hors enum est refusé.

sort.description: Code de tri côté requête, écho de l'entrée `sort` de sortInboxItems/queryInbox (défaut EV_LOSS_DESC). Les valeurs valides sont l'énumération $defs.review_sort ; tout code hors énumération est refusé par sortInboxItems (`unsupported sort`).

review_sort.description: Codes de tri valides côté requête (paramètre `sort` de sortInboxItems/queryInbox). Ensemble exhaustif supporté par l'implémentation : EV_LOSS_DESC (défaut), TIMESTAMP_DESC, TIMESTAMP_ASC, RESULT_GAIN_DESC, RESULT_LOSS_DESC, STATUS_ASC, STREET_ASC, POSITION_ASC, SPOT_FAMILY_ASC, PLAYED_ACTION_ASC, RECOMMENDED_ACTION_ASC, HAND_ID_ASC. Au minimum, les codes documentés côté requête incluent EV_LOSS_DESC, TIMESTAMP_DESC, TIMESTAMP_ASC, RESULT_GAIN_DESC, RESULT_LOSS_DESC, STATUS_ASC, STREET_ASC, POSITION_ASC et HAND_ID_ASC ; tout code hors de cette énumération est refusé.

analysis_state.description: Embedded view of the canonical contracts/analytics/analysis-state.schema.json (poker-analysis-state/v1) so an Inbox item carries one user-facing state plus the strictly separated technical dimensions. The state enum, the technical-dimension enums and the statistical_support shape (non-null integer counters plus the explicit availability signal) are kept in sync with the canonical schema.

computational_status.description: Whether the deterministic computation actually finished, kept separate from the scientific dimensions and identical to the canonical schema. NOT_EVALUATED is the explicit fail-safe status used when the producer does not supply this dimension; it must never be replaced by COMPLETE without explicit positive evidence.

statistical_support.description: Statistical/model support dimension for the hand (#408 blocker 2). The Inbox derives it from the normalized decision events, never from the number of review decisions: `observations` is the conservative minimum of `event.support.observations` over the covered+comparable decisions relevant to the hand, and unrelated model nodes are never summed. The two counters are non-null integers greater than or equal to 0, identical to the canonical schema and to the JS validator: when no decision exposes support evidence the dimension is reported with the fail-safe floor 0 together with `availability: UNKNOWN` (or `UNAVAILABLE` for an unsupported context), so missing metadata is carried by the explicit availability signal and never becomes a fabricated positive count or a null counter. `distinct_hands` is filled only from real distinct-hand evidence and stays 0 while that evidence is unavailable; it is never invented as 1.

observations.description: Conservative minimum of the real per-decision support observations over the relevant (covered+comparable) decisions. 0 together with availability UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE means unknown/unavailable (fail-safe), never the review decision count.

distinct_hands.description: Distinct backing hands only when evidenced by the events. 0 together with availability UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE means unavailable; it is never fabricated as 1.

availability.description: Explicit availability signal for the dimension, identical to the canonical schema: AVAILABLE on a positive support, UNKNOWN when the producer supplied no support evidence (never a fabricated positive count) and UNAVAILABLE when the model cannot represent the support (absent node / unsupported context). Optional for backward compatibility with producers that predate the signal; a supplied value must use the explicit vocabulary.

hero_net_bb.description: Real hero settlement of the hand in big blinds, from the optional `hand_results` input of buildReviewInboxes/buildReviewInbox. `null` means no admissible settlement evidence: the value is never coerced from malformed metadata (boolean/container/blank string) and is never invented from the EV fields.

result.description: Real-result projection of hero_net_bb. Its state is derived only from the settlement: WIN above the 1e-9 tolerance, LOSS below it, EVEN inside it and UNKNOWN when hero_net_bb is null. A missing settlement is therefore UNKNOWN, never a fabricated EVEN/0.

coverage_state.description: Backward-compatible alias of coverage.state. Never a primary user-facing label; the taxonomy analysis_state.state is the only user-facing status.

analysis_state.description: Canonical poker-analysis-state/v1 object for this hand (#393 T3). Its `state` enum is the only user-facing analysis label; coverage/reason codes stay in the secondary technical view.

analysis_state_label.description: French user-facing label for analysis_state.state. Never generic when a precise cause exists.
